name: 文件管理器
description: 在右侧工作面板中浏览、查看并编辑当前项目的文件：完整目录树（图标随文件类型变化）、左右分栏、代码高亮编辑与保存、Markdown 预览、图片与音视频查看、CSV/JSON 结构化查看，以及右键新建、重命名/移动、按文件名搜索。

en.name: File Manager
en.description: Browse, view and edit the open project in the right work panel: a full directory tree with per-file-type icons, syntax-highlighted editing, a Markdown preview, image and media viewing, CSV/JSON structured views, read-only SQLite browsing with a SQL query box, a context menu for creating and renaming, and filename search.
en.safetyNotes: Databases are opened strictly read-only (readOnly + PRAGMA query_only) and the query box only accepts single read-only statements, so a database can be browsed but never modified. Reads and writes files in the open project through Node's fs inside the plugin's own process — the host permission gateway does not mediate these calls, and the manifest cannot declare a whole-tree write. Access is confined to the project root by the plugin itself: resolved paths must stay inside the root (symlink and junction escapes are refused), credential paths (.env*, .ssh/, *.pem, .git/**) are refused, saves are atomic (temp file + rename), and overwriting a file changed outside the editor asks first. Images and media are read up to their own size limits (8 MiB / 24 MiB) and handed to the view as base64 data URIs; binaries such as zip or exe are never decoded, only reported as unsupported. No network access; the plugin data directory only holds settings and a write audit log.

zh-CN.name: 文件管理器
zh-CN.description: 在右侧工作面板中浏览、查看并编辑当前项目的文件：完整目录树（图标随文件类型变化）、左右分栏、代码高亮编辑与保存、Markdown 预览、图片与音视频查看、CSV/JSON 结构化查看、SQLite 只读浏览与 SQL 查询，以及右键新建、重命名/移动、按文件名搜索。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 数据库一律以只读方式打开（readOnly + PRAGMA query_only），SQL 框只接受单条只读语句，因此只能浏览、绝无修改；插件在自己的进程内通过 Node fs 读写当前项目的文件——宿主的权限网关不介入这些调用，manifest 也无法申报「整树写入」。访问范围由插件自身限定在项目根目录内：解析后的路径必须仍在根内（拒绝符号链接与 junction 逃逸）、拒绝凭据类路径（.env*、.ssh/、*.pem、.git/**）、保存采用原子写（临时文件 + 重命名）、覆盖在编辑器外被改动过的文件前会先询问。图片与音视频按各自上限（8 MiB / 24 MiB）读取后以 base64 data URI 交给视图；zip、exe 这类二进制只报「不支持预览」，不做任何解码。无网络访问；插件数据目录只保存设置与写入审计日志。
